title: Birraan Cirracha Jala Jiru
intro: Seenaa Qur’aanaa keessatti namni obsa guddaa qabu tokko qormaata onnee jajjaboo cabsu isa mudate. Wanti hundinuu mulqame - qabeenya, maatii, fi fayyaa. Ta’us gadi fageenya abdii kutannaa keessaa kadhannaan gad of qabuu karaa baay’ee hin eegamneen deebii argate. Lubbuu seenaan deebisanii dhaabuu ishee bara dheeraa keessatti sagalee dhageessisaa jiru kana adda baasuu dandeessaa?
clues: Qormaata baay'ee cimaa ta'een bara dheeraa keessatti yaadatamuun na qorame.
Waan barbaachisaa ta'e hunda dhabe - qabeenya koo, ijoollee koo, fi fayyaa koo.
Qaamni koo madaa dhukkubsataa taʼeen kan uwwifame siʼa taʼu, hundumaan na irraa fagaachaa ture.
Abdii kutannaa koo keessatti, sheyxaanni rakkinaa fi gidiraan na tuqe jedhee gara Rabbiin waame.
Rabbiin naaf deebisee miila kootiin dachii akkan rukutu na ajaje.
Bakka sanarraa burqaa qabbanaa’aan dhoohe, Rabbiin maatii kiyya deebisee rahmata godhee dachaa godhe.

trial.label: Yaali/Taatee
options: Dhukkuba cimaa fi maatii fi qabeenya dhabuu
Bulchaa of tuultuu waliin wal dura dhaabbachuu
trial.answer: Dhukkuba cimaa fi maatii fi qabeenya dhabuu

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Maatii fi qabeenyi deebi’ee dachaa ta’e
Bishaan addaan ba’e keessa nagaadhaan darbuu
outcome.answer: Maatii fi qabeenyi deebi’ee dachaa ta’e

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
